record.original_question: Let K ⊂ Cn be a compact set and let P0 (K) be the set of all polyno- mials on K. The P -hull of K, the polynomial convex hull of K, is defined by P -hull K = {z ∈ Cn : |p(z)| ≤ sup |P (z)| for all p ∈ P0 (K)}. k Let P (K) be the uniform closure of P0 (K) in C(K), the continuous function on K. Let Šilov Bd (P (K)) denote the Šilov boundary of the uniform algebra P (K). Determine all compact sets K ⊂ Cn (n > 1) such that Šilov Bd (P (K)) = Boundary (P -hull K). For n = 1, every compact set K ⊂ C has this property. For n > 2, examples of K are compact sets and closed spheres. (S. Kilambi)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a compact set $K\subset \mathbb{C}^n$, let $P_0(K)$ denote the algebra of (restrictions to $K$ of) polynomials in the complex coordinates $z_1,\dots,z_n$. The polynomial convex hull of $K$ is defined by
$$\widehat{K} \;=\; \{\, z\in\mathbb{C}^n : |p(z)| \le \sup_{w\in K}|p(w)| \text{ for every } p\in P_0(K)\,\}.$$
Let $P(K)$ be the uniform closure of $P_0(K)$ in the Banach algebra $C(K)$ of continuous complex-valued functions on $K$ (with the supremum norm). The Šilov boundary $\partial_S P(K)$ of the uniform algebra $P(K)$ is the smallest closed subset $S\subseteq K$ such that $\sup_{z\in S}|f(z)| = \sup_{z\in K}|f(z)|$ for every $f\in P(K)$. Let $\partial \widehat{K}$ denote the topological boundary of $\widehat{K}$ in $\mathbb{C}^n$.

It is known that for $n=1$ every compact $K\subset\mathbb{C}$ satisfies $\partial_S P(K)=\partial\widehat{K}$.

Problem. For $n>1$, characterize all compact sets $K\subset\mathbb{C}^n$ for which
$$\partial_S P(K) \;=\; \partial \widehat{K}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: A web search for the specific characterization (attributed to S. Kilambi) of compact sets $K\subset\mathbb{C}^n$ with $\partial_S P(K)=\partial\widehat{K}$ did not return any source establishing a complete solution. Standard references on polynomial convexity and Šilov boundaries discuss related results but do not appear to provide a definitive characterization in the multivariable case, so the status is unclear from available sources.

status_evidence.title: Polynomial convexity - Encyclopedia of Mathematics
status_evidence.snippet: General reference on polynomial convex hulls and uniform algebras P(K), without a characterization of when the Šilov boundary equals the topological boundary of the hull.

status_evidence.title: Shilov boundary - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Definition of the Šilov boundary of a uniform algebra; no statement specifying when it coincides with the boundary of the polynomial hull in higher dimensions.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution of the problem mentioned.
